## Working session summary

PR #331 is ready for review: https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/pull/331. Every workflow passes on the final commit (`3cf6cbe`), main is merged in, the working tree is clean, and nobody has commented on the issue or the PR.

**Changes since the earlier commits:**

- **Scheduled link check (`c04967e`).** It failed on 2026-10-05 with seven "broken" links that all worked minutes later. Three were from github.com (one 429, two 502) and four were 503s from codefactor.io. My earlier analysis said all seven came from github.com; that was wrong. lychee retries a 429 but never a 5xx, whatever `--max-retries` says (`lychee-lib/src/retry.rs`).
  - **Fix:** when lychee fails, the job waits 120 s and checks again. lychee never caches a failure, so the second pass only re-requests the failed links, and a dead link still fails.
  - **Proof:** `experiments/issue-330/lychee-5xx-retry.sh` shows a 503 gets one request and no retry, and a real 404 still fails on the second pass.
  - **Upstream:** the same cause is already diagnosed in a comment on lycheeverse/lychee#2193, so I linked it rather than filing a new issue. My earlier reports to the rust (#187), csharp (#68) and php (#18) tem

plates repeated the github.com-only claim, so I posted a correction comment on each with the reproduction and fix.
- **C# PDF job (`e803efd`).** On this PR a slow apt mirror (223 kB/s) made the 293 MB TeX Live download take 22 of the job's 30 minutes. This PR now runs that job on every C# pull request, so a slow mirror could have timed it out. The job now keeps the packages in the Actions cache. After one re-run of the job, nothing was downloaded from the mirror ("Need to get 0 B/293 MB"), and the job took about 4 minutes.
- **One warning I left in place (W10).** On this PR only, CodeQL warns "too many (300) changed files". The PR changes 373 files, 340 of them the evidence folder the issue asked for. CodeQL then runs a full scan instead of a diff-only one, so no results are lost. The warning won't appear on main or on normal-sized PRs.
- **Other changes:** I corrected all the case-study documents, added both CI logs as evidence, removed the leftover `.gitkeep` placeholder, and updated the PR title and description.

**Still needs a maintainer:** these can't be done from a pull request, and the workflows report each one as a notice or warning.
- Create the missing GitHub releases `js_0.21.0` and `rust_0.16.0`; the exact `gh release create` commands are in the PR. `js_0.23.0` will be created automatically after merge.
- Add the Java Maven Central secrets, or decide not to publish Java.
- Submit the repository to Packagist once.
- Set up PyPI trusted publishing.
- Add `CODECOV_TOKEN` for Go, or drop the Codecov upload.
